geometryDecision: Three complete full parcel polygons retained in the city-owned GeoJSON sample, including the parcel covering the saved WUP point. The actual 13-cell run returned 93 rows and 51 unique IDs; fresh exact-ID reads matched all 51 geometries. The point-containing parcel was verified, as was complete footprint-to-parcel binding. All 51 runtime polygons passed GEOS validity, positive area, ring closure, and pairwise overlap checks. No owner, address, KW, or other sensitive fields were requested or retained.

Actual backend fixed GML WFS profile completed 73 anonymous requests: 45 bounded-grid and target-footprint requests, 5 forced-page-size-3 requests, and 23 independent fresh-ID requests. All HTTP 200. Grid: 13 cells, row counts 8,7,8,8,8,15,3,1,9,2,2,13,9; 93 total response rows and 51 distinct IDs. Complete fresh exact-ID reads returned all 51 geometries matching original hashes. A deliberately absent ID PL-POZNAN-999999999999 was confirmed absent. See poznan-runtime-candidate-evidence.json for per-request count/hash/ID ledger and geometry QA.

The unchanged WUP point [52.4033374848812,16.9139953760299] is covered by parcel 306401_1.0051.AR_44.27/14. A target proposal footprint query returned 13 intersecting candidates, and computeSourceBinding reported complete coverage by one parcel with overlap 2194.582 m² against a 2194.58 m² site. A previous 40 m query had invalid EPSG:2177 axis order and its zero result was discarded.

Added a closed Poznań profile with a strict feature namespace/type/ID/geometry/CRS schema, EPSG:2177 axis conversion, safe-field projection, and no unsupported sortBy parameter. Focused source/reader tests pass; see parent review for repository-wide validation.

remainingUncertainty: The WUP centroid is a demographic locator, not a city boundary; testing does not prove full municipal or national coverage. The endpoint response confirms geometry and identifiers, not legal title, source licensing, completeness, or future availability.

geometryEvidence.geometryQA: 3 tracked polygons are complete full feature geometries selected from the runtime cache. All 51 unique runtime polygons were transformed with the official EPSG:2180 / Poland CS92 projection and GEOS-checked: valid, positive area, closed rings, no positive-area overlap above 1e-7 m², and no equal-geometry pairs.

runtimeAssessment.reason: 51 valid, distinct native EGiB parcel polygons across thirteen bounded cells around the unchanged Poznań WUP settlement locator. Before/after hit counts, all feature pages, forced three-row pagination, fresh exact reads of every ID, explicit absence, footprint lookup and one-parcel proposal binding pass. Independent EPSG:2180 full-polygon topology audit found no invalidity, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. This verifies bounded reference geometry, without asserting whole-city completeness.
